title: What If Earth Got 1% Bigger Every Day? 🌍
caption:
🌍 Day 7: it's not you, it's gravity. Day 365: you weigh as much as a pickup truck.
Which day would you leave Earth? 👇
note: Assumes Earth keeps its density, so surface gravity grows with the radius: 1.01^70 = 2.0, 1.01^160 = 4.9, 1.01^365 = 37.8 (land area x1,427). 70 kg person -> 2,645 kg on day 365.
